title: Whole Wheat Flour (Chakki Atta) Export to Australia | Patel Impex
h1: Whole Wheat Flour (Chakki Atta) Export to Australia
description: Whole Wheat Flour (Chakki Atta) export from India to Australia by Patel Impex - specification, grades, packing, certification, documentation and 18 - 24 days
html:
Patel Impex supplies Whole Wheat Flour (Chakki Atta) from Veraval (Shapar), Rajkot, Gujarat to importers, distributors, repackers and food manufacturers across Australia. We buy at the source in India's producing belts, process and pack to the specification the buyer signs off, and ship through Mundra and Kandla so every container leaves with the same documentation set and the same quality file.

This page covers everything a buyer in Australia needs before placing an order: technical specification, available grades, packing formats, quality controls, the paperwork customs will ask for, realistic transit times and the factors that move the price. If your requirement sits outside what is listed, send us the specification and we will quote against it.

Why buyers in Australia source Whole Wheat Flour (Chakki Atta) from India

India is the volume origin for flour & milled of this type, and that scale is what keeps pricing workable for a Australia importer buying container loads rather than pallets. Three things matter in practice:

  • Consistent origin. We work with the same growing regions and processing partners season after season, so the lot you approve in March behaves like the lot you receive in September.
  • Specification control. Cleaning, grading, sortex, sieving and (where relevant) steam sterilisation are set to the destination's limits before packing, not corrected afterwards.
  • Documented traceability. Every bag carries a lot code that ties back to intake, processing date, test results and the container it shipped in - what a Australia audit or recall drill will ask for.
  • One counterpart. Sourcing, processing, packing, inspection, freight booking and documentation sit with one team, so there is no gap between the supplier and the forwarder.

Whole Wheat Flour (Chakki Atta) technical specification

Moisture13% max
Protein10% - 12%
Ash content1.5% max
Gluten8% min
GranulationStone-ground chakki
AdditivesNone
HS code1101.00
Shelf life6 months
Loading portMundra / Kandla, Gujarat, India

Values above are the standard export specification. Tighter tolerances are available on contract - buyers supplying industrial bakeries, spice blenders and pharmaceutical customers in Australia routinely ask us to hold a narrower moisture or mesh band, and we quote that as a distinct grade rather than shipping against a general specification.

Grades we ship to Australia

  • Chakki atta
  • Multigrain atta
  • High-protein atta

If your Australia customers sit across more than one price point, we can run two or three grades in the same container with separate lot codes and separate certificates of analysis, so retail and food-service volumes move on one bill of lading.

Packing and container loading

  • PP / paper bags 5, 10, 25, 50 kg
  • Retail packs 1 - 10 kg
  • Buyer-branded pouches

Standard export packing is palletised and stretch-wrapped, with desiccant and container liners on request for the humidity a Melbourne / Sydney discharge can involve. A 20 ft container carries roughly 18 - 20 MT in bags; a 40 ft high cube is used where volume rather than weight is the constraint, which is common for bulky or light-density lines. Palletised loading is available where your Australia warehouse handles forklifts only.

Quality control and certification

Quality is checked three times: at intake, in process and after packing. Raw material is rejected at intake if moisture or foreign matter is out of band - it is far cheaper than reworking a finished lot. Finished goods are tested for the parameters listed above plus microbiology and pesticide residues where the commodity and destination require it, and a certificate of analysis travels with every shipment.

We operate to FSSAI registration in India and support APEDA and Spices Board documentation, ISO 22000 and HACCP-aligned processing partners, halal and kosher certification on request, and organic certification for the lines where it is offered. Third-party pre-shipment inspection by SGS, Bureau Veritas or Intertek can be arranged and is billed at cost.

Export documentation for Australia

Biosecurity import permit, fumigation certificate and country-of-origin labelling. Alongside destination paperwork, each shipment carries the commercial invoice, packing list with lot-level detail, bill of lading or airway bill, certificate of origin, phytosanitary certificate where applicable, fumigation certificate where the packing requires it, insurance certificate on CIF terms and the certificate of analysis. We send the full draft set for your approval before the originals are couriered, which is the simplest way to avoid a demurrage bill at Melbourne / Sydney.

Shipping and lead time

Production and quality clearance take about 5 - 7 working days for stock grades and 10 - 15 days where a custom specification or printed private-label packing is involved. Sea transit from Mundra or Kandla to Melbourne / Sydney is typically 18 - 24 days on direct services, longer where the routing transships. Air freight is practical for samples and for pharma-grade or high-value spice lots. We quote FOB, CFR and CIF, and can work with your nominated forwarder in Australia if you prefer to control the freight leg yourself.

What moves the price

Four things: the crop position in the producing belt, the grade and tolerance you specify, the packing format, and the freight rate on the India - Australia lane at the time of booking. Because these move independently, our quotes are valid for a defined window and state the grade, packing, Incoterm and payment terms explicitly. For programme buyers we hold seasonal contracts that fix the specification and the price band for an agreed volume, which removes most of the volatility from your landed cost.

How to order

Send us the product, grade, quantity, packing and delivery port. We reply with a written quotation, a specification sheet and a sample dispatch where you need one. Once the specification is approved we confirm the contract, produce, inspect, stuff and ship - with progress updates at each stage and full document scans before the vessel sails. Contact Patel Impex or call +91 99748 73171 to start.

Frequently asked questions

What is the minimum order quantity for Whole Wheat Flour (Chakki Atta) to Australia?

For bagged consignments we start at one 20 ft container, which typically holds 18 - 20 MT of whole wheat flour (chakki atta) depending on the packing you choose. Buyers in Australia testing a new label often begin with a mixed container combining whole wheat flour (chakki atta) with another Patel Impex line to keep freight cost per kilo low.

Which documents travel with a Whole Wheat Flour (Chakki Atta) shipment to Australia?

Every consignment leaves Gujarat with a commercial invoice, packing list, bill of lading, certificate of origin, phytosanitary certificate where the commodity requires one, a third-party certificate of analysis and any Australia-specific paperwork. Biosecurity import permit, fumigation certificate and country-of-origin labelling.

How long does shipping take from India to Australia?

Transit from Mundra or Kandla to Melbourne / Sydney runs about 18 - 24 days on direct services, plus roughly 5 - 7 working days for production, quality clearance, stuffing and documentation before the vessel sails.

Can we buy under our own brand?

Yes. We handle private-label whole wheat flour (chakki atta) with buyer artwork, destination-compliant declarations, barcodes and batch coding. Artwork is proofed and approved digitally before any print run starts.

What payment terms do you offer?

We work on advance TT, irrevocable letter of credit at sight and, for repeat buyers with an established track record, documents against payment. Terms are quoted per contract along with FOB, CFR or CIF pricing.

How is quality verified before shipment?

Each lot is sampled at intake and again after packing. We test moisture, foreign matter, microbiology and pesticide residues against the limits that apply in Australia, and we are happy to appoint SGS, Bureau Veritas or Intertek for pre-shipment inspection at the buyer's request.
